title: Kernel tuning: H100 attention kernel variant selection + fallback rules + telemetry
creator: Talia Benson
project: Hardware tuning profiles pack (Serving Runtime Performance — Kernel + Scheduling)
description:
Goal
- Select the best-known H100 attention kernel variant for production serving based on workload shape and runtime constraints.
- Make the selection and fallbacks observable: counters + tags to correlate perf deltas and regressions with kernel choice.
- Provide safe fallbacks that prioritize correctness and stability over peak throughput.

Context
- Part of the Hardware Tuning Profiles Pack effort. H100 is our highest-volume SKU for latency-sensitive Dedicated and Hosted tiers; tail-latency regressions have historically correlated with “silent” kernel fallbacks when shapes drift (long contexts, uncommon head dims, certain quantization/dtypes).

Scope
1) Kernel variant selection (H100)
- Introduce/enable H100 attention kernel variant “v3” as the preferred path when compatible.
- Define deterministic selection rules, including explicit compatibility checks and a single source of truth for the decision.
- Ensure behavior is stable across model reloads and mixed workloads.

2) Fallback rules
- Explicitly enumerate fallback order (v3 → v2 → baseline) and reasons.
- Fallback must be safe under:
  - long context / high KV cache pressure
  - mixed prefill+decode loads
  - common quantization modes we ship (fp16/bf16; int8/int4 where applicable)

3) Telemetry
- Export kernel choice + fallback counters/histograms with low-cardinality labels.
- Make it possible to answer: “what percent of traffic is actually using v3?” and “are we falling back for unexpected reasons?”

Non-goals
- Net-new kernel implementation from scratch for all model families.
- Overfitting selection rules to a single benchmark; we want broadly safe defaults.

Proposed selection policy (initial)
- Prefer v3 when all conditions hold:
  - GPU SKU == H100 (SXM/PCIe both OK)
  - dtype in {bf16, fp16} for q/k/v (quantized path guarded; see below)
  - head_dim in supported set (initially 64/80/128; confirm with Grace/Yuki)
  - sequence length window within v3 limits (guarded by prefill_len and kv_len)
  - no known-bad driver/CUDA combos (compatibility matrix maintained in profile pack)
- Otherwise fall back to v2, else baseline.

Quantization note
- For int8/int4 attention paths: do not force v3 until we have benchmark coverage + correctness confidence. If a quantized model loads on H100, default to v2 unless explicitly enabled by profile pack version + compatibility allowlist.

Telemetry spec (initial)
Metrics (names tentative; align with observability-pack conventions):
- runtime_attention_kernel_choice_total{sku, model_family, kernel_variant}++
- runtime_attention_kernel_fallback_total{sku, model_family, from_variant, to_variant, reason}++
- runtime_attention_kernel_unsupported_shape_total{sku, reason}++
- runtime_attention_kernel_init_ms histogram (optional; init/compile overhead if any)

Labels (keep cardinality bounded)
- sku: "h100"
- model_family: "llama", "mixtral", "qwen", "other" (coarse)
- kernel_variant: "v3" | "v2" | "baseline"
- reason: enumerated string (see below)

Fallback reasons (enum)
- unsupported_head_dim
- unsupported_dtype
- unsupported_quantization_mode
- seq_len_out_of_range
- driver_cuda_incompatible
- insufficient_smem_or_register_pressure
- runtime_flag_disabled
- unknown_error

Acceptance criteria
- [ ] On H100 benchmark matrix buckets, v3 is selected for the intended majority of supported shapes (target: >= 80% of traffic in the “standard” buckets uses v3).
- [ ] All fallbacks are explicit, enumerated, and show up in counters.
- [ ] No correctness regressions on conformance tests; any runtime exceptions trigger a fallback with reason=unknown_error and increment counter.
- [ ] Kernel selection is deterministic across restarts and model reloads.
- [ ] Perf-canary can attribute deltas to kernel_variant (via tags/counters).

Rollout plan
- Behind profile pack feature flag, enabled only for Hosted canary cohort initially.
- Dedicated: opt-in (profile pin) until we have 2 weeks of clean signals.

Links
- Epic: ENG-4921
- Related: ENG-4923 (selection logic wiring), ENG-4922 (schema/compat), ENG-4931 (observability tags)
- Candidate implementation PR: https://github.com/redwood/redwood/pull/24911
comments: 2026-01-10 (Talia Benson): Creating per kickoff thread. Kernel owner: Hiro. Please coordinate with Sofia/Marcus on perf-canary attribution needs and with Allison on metric naming/tagging.

2026-01-14 (Hiro Tanaka): Drafted selection rules for v3 vs v2 based on microbench results. Biggest wins on decode-heavy and mid context (2k–8k) shapes. Long-context prefill (>=16k) shows more variance; proposing guardrail to keep v2 for very long prefill until we expand coverage.

2026-01-16 (Grace Kim): v3 supports head_dim {64, 128} confidently; head_dim=80 is “works” but needs more testing due to register pressure spikes on certain driver builds. Suggest gating 80 behind compatibility allowlist initially.

2026-01-21 (Yuki Sato): Please ensure we log both the chosen kernel and the first fallback reason. We’ve had past incidents where we only saw the final variant and couldn’t tell why the fast path wasn’t used.

2026-01-27 (Allison Grant): Metric guidance: avoid per-model labels. model_family is OK if kept to <10 values. Reason enum is fine. Please also expose a gauge-like periodic log line at startup with default variant for common buckets (for on-call quick checks).

2026-02-03 (Hiro Tanaka): PR 24911 up with v3 + fallback and kernel_choice metric. Needs review from Noah for where the selection lives (kernel module vs runtime init) and from Omar for metrics conventions.

2026-02-07 (Noah Patel): Reviewed PR directionally OK. Request: make selection function pure + unit tested (input: sku/driver/cuda/dtype/head_dim/seq_len flags → output: variant + reason). This prevents drift across call sites.
2026-02-11 (Omar El-Sayed): Add fallback_total counter with from/to + reason. Also add a separate counter for “unsupported_shape” so we can alert on it without conflating with driver incompat.

2026-02-18 (Hiro Tanaka): Updated PR per feedback: extracted pure selector + tests; added fallback_total and unsupported_shape_total; reason enum now centralized. Remaining: decide initial support for head_dim=80 (currently gated off).

2026-02-20 (Sean Gallagher): From SRE: ensure runtime_flag_disabled is a reason so we can distinguish config issues from real incompatibility. Also ensure we can correlate with profile_id/profile_version tags (ENG-4931). Marking In Review pending final approvals.
